Overview

Elko is a city in NV with a population of 20,000. Northeastern Nevada’s mining and ranching hub with the National Cowboy Poetry Gathering. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.3.
